description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange Effective from 21.03.2022 to 27.03.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and establishes new rates of exchange for customs duties and charges. It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations, falls under legal/regulatory matters, and does not involve government personnel changes, structural changes, or any of the other specialized categories.
